releases.title: Catalog eligibility recovery
notes: Preserve broad national scope while enforcing explicit artist-origin, scene, language, and recording-location answers with country/demonym-aware evidence.
Stop deterministic geography-evidence mismatches from triggering futile paid refill rounds, and discard malformed generated complement exclusions.
Prefer clean canonical Apple Music issues over misleading compilations, seasonal promotions, and remasters, while respecting non-chronological sequencing requests.

releases.title: Open-ended scope and catalog recovery
notes: Parses open-ended era requests such as 1970s through today as continuous current-year ranges instead of single-decade hard constraints.
Treats iconic, essential, classic, definitive, and representative as soft curation preferences while preserving strict evidence for ranked or influential requests.
Filters count, diversity, and era instructions from Apple deficit queries without dropping genuine composite music scope.
Reports only durable manifested tracks as selected in partial outcome counters.
Captures the live production incident in the frozen scenario suite and classifies safe count shortfalls as typed partial results, never system failures.

releases.title: Apple catalog alias reconciliation
notes: Accepts Apple Music storefront ID canonicalization only when exact artist and title, compatible duration, and version policy prove the same recording family.
Preserves strict rejection and orphan recovery for genuine playlist ordering or version conflicts.

releases.title: Portable Sites production build
notes: Made the production build invoke release validation directly so Sites can compile the exact tagged source even when its package-manager shim is not exported to nested scripts.

releases.title: Atomic Pipeline V2 catalog recovery
notes: Committed trusted Apple editorial evidence, exact catalog identity, match outcome, and candidate state atomically so worker interruptions cannot strand playable tracks.
Bounded exact-match scores to PostgreSQL's numeric contract and classified post-discovery persistence faults as local handoff errors instead of provider degradation.
Prioritized trusted scoped playlists, planned Apple search waves against the real 25-song page size, and rejected editorial containers whose titles do not declare the requested music scope.
Resolved evidence-backed release collisions deterministically and kept automatic review-to-publication handoffs visibly active instead of presenting a manual review state.

releases.title: Pipeline V2 catalog handoff hardening
notes: Promoted trusted Apple editorial identities in bounded chunks before optional enrichment, preventing large discovery pages from exhausting the matching window before usable tracks become durable.
Reserved matching time for catalog handoff and re-read exact identities before timeout bookkeeping so accepted Apple matches cannot be overwritten by bulk timeout outcomes.
Kept inferred subject geography as a discovery preference while preserving explicit prompt and guided-answer geography as hard scope.
Treated geographic alternatives inside one relationship as OR while retaining AND across distinct requested relationships, with prior-policy compatibility for in-flight runs.
Distinguished canonical Original Mix releases from actual remixes and treated conditionally allowed edits as fallbacks rather than preferred versions.
Added production-scale regressions for catalog-page handoff, exact-match concurrency, broad house scope, explicit Chicago scope, geographic alternatives, and version classification.

releases.title: Pipeline V2 catalog activation fix
notes: Fixed conditional remaster language so canonical recordings remain eligible when later reissues are allowed only if they preserve the original recording identity.
Recognized original-era recording language as a canonical-version preference instead of narrowing the catalog to remasters.
Added typed fixed-release scope detection for natural requests such as songs from a named album while keeping broad soundtrack and multi-album prompts diverse.
Kept every album mismatch, artist catalogue, factual request, competing recording, parenthetical variant, and version or identifier conflict on the strict review path.
Added production-shaped regressions for the Brazilian disco canary, conditional version policies, exact-count manifest assembly, and fixed-album protection.

releases.title: Pipeline V2 manifest survival recovery
notes: Made exact-fill recovery count only Apple matches that can survive the final evidence, scope, era, content, and version-policy floor.
Derived genre, geography, and era eligibility from persisted citation attestations instead of prompt-shaped notes or generic source labels.
Used compatible recording-family issue dates so modern Apple reissues no longer disqualify evidence-backed period recordings.
Preserved disjoint requested eras and deduplicated alternate Apple editions by canonical recording family before exact-fill and manifest selection.
Fixed version-policy negation and unless clauses, including requests that reject live or remix versions while retaining canonical recordings.
Retried version-policy conflicts through broader Apple lookup and added production-shaped regressions for Brazilian disco and boogie, adaptive refill, and modern reissue handling.

releases.title: Pipeline V2 scope normalization hotfix
notes: Merged alternative prompt dimensions into single hard scope rules so multi-era, multi-genre, multilingual, and multi-region requests no longer become impossible conjunctions.
Prevented model-resolved subject fragments from narrowing a scope axis already defined by the visitor's prompt.
Made version-policy parsing respect include and exclude polarity so avoiding live versions or remixes never turns them into preferred catalog matches.
Added production-shaped regressions for Brazilian disco across the 1970s and 1980s and for mixed positive and negative recording-version policies.

releases.title: Pipeline V2 manifest eligibility hotfix
notes: Fixed manifest locking so strong citation-attested track evidence remains eligible when its upstream provenance lineage cannot be independently classified.
Kept unknown-lineage sources collapsed into one corroboration bucket, preventing copied pages from appearing independently verified.
Preserved both decades in multi-era requests and prevented model-authored exclusions from contradicting the visitor's explicit era scope.
Preserved real candidate-stage counts in zero-result coverage reports instead of replacing resolved catalog stages with zeros.
Added regression coverage for unknown-lineage evidence, contradictory generated exclusions, and multi-decade selection plans.

releases.title: Curated Pipeline V2 activation
notes: Activated the catalog-first Pipeline V2 route for curated genre and scene requests.
Fixed cited source relationship validation that could discard an entire valid candidate pool before Apple Music matching.
Prevented model-authored scope prose from becoming hidden hard intent, exclusion, venue, activity, era, or multilingual requirements.
Added deterministic Apple catalog recovery when hosted research yields no usable candidates, while retaining transparent partial outcomes.

releases.title: Live research console
notes: Replaced the generic playlist loader with a six-stage live research console and an honest indeterminate activity trace.
Added live source, evidence, candidate, Apple matching, frontier, container, and publication metadata while research is running.
Added recent-source labels, elapsed and freshness context, reduced-motion behavior, and a single accessible status announcement.

releases.title: Pipeline V2 QA hardening
notes: Hardened staged Apple discovery against malformed pages, multilingual alias collisions, unsafe cursors, incomplete pagination, and corrupted resume checkpoints.
Separated factual, editorial, similarity, and genre evidence so one claim cannot silently prove another or inherit prompt text as source evidence.
Unified evidence strength across catalog matching and manifest locking, and expanded factual routing for worked-on and recorded-with requests.
Made completion outcomes exact: shortfalls stay transparent partial results, while over-publication and integrity failures remain operationally distinct.
Stabilized the complete responsive browser QA matrix and added regression coverage for every defect found in this release audit.

releases.title: Relevance-first pipeline foundation
notes: Added a versioned relevance-first selection plan for curated requests while preserving the claim-first factual and exhaustive workflow.
Added subject-specific guidance, typed constraints, and explicit disambiguation for genre, scene, geography, similarity, and factual relationships.
Added track-scope evidence bindings, recording families, catalog alternates, candidate-stage counters, and a diagnostic deficit ledger.
Added adaptive exact-fill recovery, immutable manifest revisions, and safe partial or no-compatible-track outcomes instead of count-shortfall errors.
Added pinned Luna and Terra model routing with bounded scout and playlist-size research budgets visible only to the owner.
Added the Pipeline V2 discovery controller and policy contracts for staged rollout without reinterpreting existing V1 runs.
Added mixed-version worker leasing so V1 and V2 jobs remain isolated during deploys, rollback, and worker restart recovery.
Added a storefront-scoped Apple catalog cache with request fingerprints, bounded TTLs, and durable hit and provider-state telemetry.

releases.title: Production baseline
notes: Added live progress animation and phase messaging during research, matching, and publication.
Added grounded, request-specific follow-up questions before research.
Improved genre disambiguation, artist diversity, sequencing, and cited candidate refills.
Improved Apple Music matching recovery and partial-result handling when the requested count cannot be resolved safely.
Added the public playlist directory and private owner feedback inbox with screenshot support.
